content:
You’re doing well building the foundation of your Warrior I. Let’s make a few adjustments to help you feel stronger, more aligned, and more stable.

First, notice your spine. Right now, it isn’t quite straight. Try lengthening through the crown of your head and gently lifting your chest while keeping your torso tall. Imagine creating one long line from your hips up through the top of your head.

Next, bring your arms straight up overhead. Reach through your fingertips with energy, and keep the arms active and extended. This will help you feel more lifted and engaged in the pose.

Finally, check your front knee. It should be directly over your ankle. Gently adjust your stance so the knee stacks over the ankle, giving you a stronger and safer base.

Take your time with these corrections. You’re very close—focus on steady breathing, length through the spine, strong arms, and that knee-over-ankle alignment.
